notes.title: 7K already?! In ONE day?! You wild, love ya! COMMING SOON!
notes.notes:
[p]🎉 [b]Hey everyone, exciting news![/b]
Incredible news! In just one day, 7,000 real pranksters and clowns are ready to play this — dare I say — MASTERPIECE! We’re excited to let you play absolutely free on THREE maps with a huge variety of modes! Coming very soon!! Like, really soon![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45672950/95e83640ddbd5c9a79b15fa29e1e1c70fe6290c3.png"][/img][/p]

notes.notes:
